devnative.role: reported only; it cannot change the decision
devnative.frozen: devnative.status COHORT_FROZEN f5a1dbd0ad15317e73e1b1e030eb88acf3d79861 (origin/feat/devnative, docs/devnative.md), written before this protocol and before any study-1b score
devnative.reported: every file separately (devnative's docs: report each file, never pool tv_native with teacher_val), and study 2's pooled devnative set (strict + tv_native, ink + grad crops, eval/synth3_study2.py merge; VNs resampled as clusters)
devnative.note: native Vita and PSP console frames only; every devnative VN is a teacher_val VN and 421 tv_native lines overlap a teacher_val line, so it is not independent of teacher_val

metric: CER (eval/metrics.norm both sides, Levenshtein over reference characters) over all development lines, both views, errors summed over the arm's two seeds
decision: D_s3v3 is better than B_s3 iff the VN-cluster 95% interval of CER(D_s3v3) - CER(B_s3) on teacher_val (both views, errors summed over the arm's two seeds) lies entirely below 0 and CER(D_s3v3) - CER(B_s3) < 0 for each seed pair (same seed). Otherwise version 3 is not measured better: version 2 stays synth3's VN-style data and the result is reported as no measured improvement (study 1's rule).
reported_not_decided: the mirrored reading (B_s3 better than D_s3v3: interval entirely above 0 and every seed pair above 0)
every stratum of eval/synth3_ablation.py (target, kind, polarity, ink height, length, name-like, dakuten/small kana, rare kanji, Latin/digits) with intervals, on teacher_val
devnative: each file and the pooled set, with the same statistics
per-VN better/worse counts and the largest per-VN regressions (no per-VN veto)
the in-training teacher_val and synthetic validation curves
study 1's B_s3 scores (32-core box) next to this rerun, for machine-to-machine variation
